name: request_promote
description:
Promote an existing deployment to production for a project. This does not rebuild the deployment; use create_deployment to build a new one.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v10/projects/{projectId}/promote/{deploymentId} --method POST. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
